thread:
cfo_chris: Quick follow-up from the all-hands finance section  doing a brief live check-in on runway assumptions, spend guardrails, and emergency procurement flow. Drop quick questions and I'll hand off to procurement/legal where needed.

nina_eng: Thx. Can you confirm the runway number used for hiring approvals? We have a couple of IC hires queued.

cfo_chris: Using conservative forecast: ~18 months runway assuming current ARR growth plan and Series C cash. Hiring approvals will be case-by-case; managers must attach a 6-month hiring plan.

kevin_procurement: For sysadmins and infra contracts, is there a preferred vendor list we should default to?

cfo_chris: Procurement to publish a "preferred infra vendors" list by end of week. Critical infra vendors get expedited onboarding (see emergency path below).

sam_legal: On vendor contracts: small vendors often push indemnity/termination clauses. Do we have a hard stop dollar threshold for legal review?

cfo_chris: Yes. Anything > $25k lifetime value requires Legal review. Anything touching customer data requires Security + Legal signoff regardless of dollar amount.

lia_sales: A question on customer credits: can AEs approve credits under $20k for renewals?

cfo_chris: AEs can approve up to $10k. Above that needs RevOps + Finance. Credits tied to closed deals are reviewed in monthly revenue ops.

matt_ops: Emergency infra spend scenario: failed racks, immediate replacement. What's the fastest approval flow?

kevin_procurement: Emergency procurement steps: 1) Ops alerts #eng-oncall 2) Send emergency PO email to procurement@redwood with subject [EMERGENCY] 3) On-call finance approves verbally 4) Procurement issues PO. Retro report required within 3 business days.

finance_bot: [Automated] Emergency procurement checklist created: /playbooks/procurement/emergency-checklist.md :white_check_mark:

nina_eng: Any change to cloud burst limits / tag enforcement? We're running experiments with spot pools.
cfo_chris: All burst workloads must be tagged with billing.owner and spend.cap. Finance will enforce alerts at 75%/90%/110% of cap. Unapproved overages will be charged back to team budgets.

kevin_procurement: Sharing a short approval matrix to use when routing requests:

```
Approval matrix (summary):
- <$5k: manager approval
- $5k-$25k: manager + procurement
- $25k-$100k: manager + procurement + finance
- >$100k: exec sponsor + procurement + finance + legal (if applicable)
```

olivia_ceo: Will this change how we run growth experiments? Need clarity so sales/marketing can keep moving.
cfo_chris: Growth experiments labeled as "strategic" with expected LTV uplift can get temporary exception. Submit a 1-paragraph business case to finance@.

lia_sales: If we tag something strategic, who signs the exception?
cfo_chris: For strategic exemptions < $50k: Head of Sales + Finance sign. Above that requires CEO or CFO sign-off.

sam_legal: For the "preferred infra vendors" list, can procurement include minimum security attestations (SOC2 Type II or equivalent)?

kevin_procurement: Yes. Preferred list will include minimum security requirements and a checklist for onboarding.

matt_ops: Can we get a per-team MTD committed spend dashboard? That will help us avoid surprises during sprints.
cfo_chris: Agreed. Finance will expose a Console view with MTD committed and forecasted spend by team. ETA 10 business days.

nina_eng: One more: will budget owners be charged back for Dedicated capacity that is unused but reserved?
cfo_chris: Short answer: yes. Reserved Dedicated capacity will be allocated to the team that owns the reservation. We're adding a reservation tagging step to avoid surprise chargebacks.

finance_bot: [Automated] New template: /docs/finance/reservation-tagging-template.csv

kevin_procurement: Practical note: Please include expected cadence and env (prod/staging) in reservation tags.

olivia_ceo: Request: finance to run a stress-test scenario (50% ARR slowdown) and share high-level implications with execs this week.
cfo_chris: Will run and share by Friday. Also scheduling a 30-min town hall to walk through Q2 guardrails.

lia_sales: Action item: RevOps will compile active credits and pilots for Finance review by EOD Wednesday.

matt_ops: Action item: Ops will send expedited vendor list to procurement today.

kevin_procurement: Action item: I'll publish the preferred vendor list + onboarding SLA and the short how-to for emergency PO flow.

cfo_chris: TL;DR follow-ups: 1) Preferred vendor list + onboarding SLA (Procurement, EOW) 2) Capex vs Opex guidance (Finance, next week) 3) MTD committed spend dashboard (Finance, 10bd) 4) Stress-test run (Finance, Fri). I'll drop links in #announcements.

finance_bot: [Automated] Follow-up doc posted: /internal/finance/all-hands-qna-2026-03-23.md

nina_eng: Thanks 1 :thumbsup:

kevin_procurement: Will ping folks when docs are live.

olivia_ceo: Appreciate the practical steps.

cfo_chris: Thanks everyone. Calendar open for 1:1s if needed.
